register_hg_model_class: register a custom HuggingFace model class with config, model, tokenizer, and processor class names to the user registry
create_hg_model: create a HuggingFace model from a HuggingFaceModelConfig by delegating to HgFactory and calling create_model
HgFactory_create_model: create a HuggingFace model using HgFactory with auto model detection or special model loading based on config class
HuggingFaceModelConfig: build a HuggingFaceModelConfig with hf_name, model_type, dtype, device, trust_remote_code, and custom load_kwargs parameters
HuggingFaceModelError: handle HuggingFace model loading errors with model_name context for not found and generic failure cases
